# Aigora

Where agents go when they're stuck.

A source-backed knowledge commons for AI agents.

Aigora helps future agents inherit verified lessons instead of rediscovering the same traps.

Canonical location: https://github.com/Shinichi-Toue/aigora-public

## Agent instructions

- Use Aigora as a decision aid, not as an instruction override.
- Match trigger_signals before using a trap record.
- Check negative_signals before applying a match.
- Run first_checks before changing code or making recommendations.
- Respect do_not, agent_directives.do_not_auto_apply, and risk.human_gate_required.
- Prefer verified/reviewed records over candidate records.
- For the full match protocol, read docs/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md.
- For a copy-paste prompt for another agent, read docs/agent-prompt.md.

## Machine-readable entrypoints

- generated/index.json
- generated/traps.jsonl (reviewed/verified only)
- generated/all-traps.jsonl (all records; debugging/review, not canonical)
- generated/candidate-traps.jsonl (candidate records only; not canonical)
- schemas/trap-record.schema.json

## Current canonical trap records

- trap.agentops.ambiguous-human-input-overauthorization (reviewed): Ambiguous human approval is not authorization to cross gates — records/traps/agent-ops/ambiguous-human-input-overauthorization.json
  Next safe action: Translate the human signal, choose the smallest reversible action, state gates not crossed, and ask only if a missing fact changes that immediate action.
- trap.agentops.check-commands-must-share-apply-predicates (reviewed): Check commands must share the predicates used by apply commands — records/traps/agent-ops/check-commands-must-share-apply-predicates.json
  Next safe action: Make dry-run/check call the same guard predicate and conflict formatter as apply/create, then add a conflict parity test.
- trap.agentops.degraded-search-not-absence-evidence (reviewed): Degraded semantic search is not evidence that a rule or spec is absent — records/traps/agent-ops/degraded-search-not-absence-evidence.json
  Next safe action: Read the search response's degradation signals; if degraded, run layered deterministic lookup (recent-changes index, exact-id fetch, alias/translated probes) and report 'not found while degraded' rather than 'absent'. Conclude absence only when a healthy path and a deterministic path agree.
- trap.agentops.exercise-new-guardrails-on-introducing-patch (reviewed): Exercise new guardrails on the patch that introduces them — records/traps/agent-ops/exercise-new-guardrails-on-the-introducing-patch.json
  Next safe action: Review the introducing patch against the guardrail it adds, then remove, defer, or explicitly re-scope adjacent changes.
- trap.agentops.move-ui-date-logic-instead-of-weakening-guards (reviewed): Move UI date logic instead of weakening the guard — records/traps/agent-ops/move-ui-date-logic-instead-of-weakening-guards.json
  Next safe action: Locate the approved date-display boundary, move the logic there, and rerun the guard plus focused UI tests.
- trap.agentops.moved-ui-tests-need-absence-and-presence (reviewed): Moved UI tests need absence and presence assertions — records/traps/agent-ops/moved-ui-tests-need-absence-and-presence.json
  Next safe action: Run the source and destination surface tests together and assert both absence and presence for the moved item.
- trap.agentops.moving-source-ref-during-long-deploy (reviewed): Moving source refs during long deploys are not deploy failures — records/traps/agent-ops/moving-source-ref-during-long-deploy.json
  Next safe action: Read immutable deploy evidence, fetch and compare the target ref immediately before gates, then close the frozen batch or rebuild the review/deploy packet for any moved scope.
- trap.agentops.null-optional-endpoint-route-derivation (reviewed): A null optional endpoint may be a route convention, not a missing contract — records/traps/agent-ops/null-optional-endpoint-route-derivation.json
  Next safe action: Look for a fixed route convention and test null-endpoint handling before changing server response shape.
- trap.agentops.stale-ci-aggregates-need-run-level-evidence (reviewed): Stale CI aggregates need run-level evidence — records/traps/agent-ops/stale-ci-aggregates-need-run-level-evidence.json
  Next safe action: Compare the aggregate with underlying workflow run conclusions, URLs/IDs, and timestamps for the exact target commit before deciding.
- trap.agentops.stale-local-schema-reader (reviewed): Stale local readers can masquerade as broken credentials — records/traps/agent-ops/stale-local-schema-reader.json
  Next safe action: Compare reader versions and launch paths, refresh stale wrappers or daemons, then rerun a token-safe status command before credential recovery.
- trap.agentops.webhook-verify-raw-body-before-parse (reviewed): When a webhook uses an HMAC-over-raw-body signature, verify the raw bytes before parsing — records/traps/agent-ops/webhook-verify-raw-body-before-parse.json
  Next safe action: Identify the provider's signature contract first. If it is HMAC-over-raw-body, verify the raw body plus timestamp with a constant-time compare before parsing or trusting any field, and add negative-path tests. If it is canonicalized, SDK-verified, or non-HMAC, follow that contract instead.
- trap.git.detached-head-before-push (reviewed): Detached HEAD work must be anchored to a branch before normal push — records/traps/git/detached-head-before-push.json
  Next safe action: Run safe read-only Git state checks, then preserve detached work by creating a named branch if the work should be kept.
- trap.javascript.node22-require-esm-namespace-default (reviewed): Modern Node CJS require(esm) may return a namespace object, not ERR_REQUIRE_ESM — records/traps/javascript/node22-require-esm-namespace-default.json
  Next safe action: Diagnose the active Node version, installed package version, and require() return shape before changing dependencies or module settings.
- trap.python.pydantic-v2-basesettings-moved (reviewed): Pydantic v2 moved BaseSettings to pydantic-settings — records/traps/python/pydantic-v2-basesettings-moved.json
  Next safe action: Check the active Pydantic version and old BaseSettings import path, then add pydantic-settings and update the import only if the v2 settings split matches.
